item.title: Nebraska ag land values increase for second consecutive year
item.description: The value of agricultural land in Nebraska increased by an average of 6% over the prior year, to a statewide average of $2,895 per acre, according to the preliminary findings of the University of Nebraska–Lincoln’s 2021 Farm Real Estate Market Survey. item.title: USDA announces $23 million in grant funding to support the U.S. dairy industry

item.title: Fridays in the Field: Nebraska Producers Reflect on Harvest Progress and a Season of Extremes
item.description: Nebraska farmers say late-season rains turned a dry start into a productive harvest. Producers near Humboldt, Eddyville, and Sumner report strong yields, disease pressure, and gratitude for teamwork and favorable fall weather.
